title: Daq core
description: A pinned 'how it works' section 230% of the window tall on solid black: a monospace eyebrow and a large sentence-case title, a numbered list of four steps on a hairline rail at the left, and a square bordered panel (title with a dimmed second word, a monospace legend, a live status label, a diagram slot, a caption and progress dashes) at the right. As you scroll through the pin the active step advances: its description opens, the rail segment and the step names light up, and the panel's status and dashes follow.
notes: needs JavaScript to advance the steps (hydrate: visible); without it the first step is open
the diagram slot takes an image, video or your own SVG; empty, it is a dashed placeholder
on phones the steps sit above the panel and the panel's caption gets its own row
